description.value: Deepwater Micro Eatery is a casual North Vancouver restaurant focused on Pacific seafood, offering fish & chips with wild BC cod, halibut, and salmon alongside a broad taco and burger menu. It has both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable stop in any weather. A solid selection of canned craft beer, cider, and wine rounds out the offering for cyclists looking to refuel after a ride.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 16m; stands (1 space) at 52m; rack (3 spaces) at 80m; stands (1 space) at 100m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is an active Square-powered online ordering portal confirming the restaurant is open and serving the menu categories listed in OSM (tacos, burgers, fish & chips, beer). Multiple gluten-free and vegetarian items are explicitly labelled on the menu (e.g. Veggie Tacos, Black Bean Brown Rice Burger, GF taco options). Pickup/delivery options are present, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging on the website, so those remain null.
concerns: The fetched website content is entirely an ordering interface with no standard about/contact page, so phone number and address could not be corroborated from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant with a functioning online ordering system, indoor and outdoor seating, and a substantial food menu well-suited to hungry cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple gluten-free items explicitly labelled (all taco varieties marked 'gluten-free, dairy free'). Vegetarian options include Veggie Tacos and Black Bean Brown Rice Burger

wow_evidence: both indoor and outdoor seating ... solid selection of canned craft beer, cider, and wine
